definition: אֶשְׁכּוֺל ( אֶשְׁכֹּל Song 7:8 ) noun masculine Num 13:23 cluster (Ethiopic , Arabic , Aramaic אִיתְכְּלָא ; etymology dubious; Thes MV below √ שׁכל , but no suitable meaning proven; Sta § 258; 300 derives from √ אשׁך with afformative ל ) — ׳ א absolute Num 13:24 +; construct v Num 13:23 +; plural אַשְׁכֹּלוֺת Song 7:8 construct אַשְׁכְּלֹת Deut 32:32 , אֶשְׁכְּלוֺת Song 7:9 suffix אַשְׁכְּלֹתֶיהָ Gen 40:10 — 1. cluster of grapes, עֲנָבִים ׳ א Num 13:23 compare v Num 13:24 see also Gen 40:10 הִבְשִׁילוּ עֲנָבִים ׳ א its clusters ripened grapes ; hence figurative of deeds of enemies of Israel, clusters of gall have they Deut 32:32 (|| עִנְבֵי רוֺשׁ ); figurative of Israel Isa 65:8 ׳ יִמָּצֵא הַתִּירוֺשׁ בְּא ; Mic 7:1 אֵין אֶשְׁכּוֺל לֶאֱכוֺל figurative of desolation of Israel under Yahweh's judgment; Song 7:9 in simile שָׁדַיִךְ כְּאֶשְׁכְּלוֺת הַגֶּפֶן compare v. Song 7:8 (where Thes MV think of clusters of dates, see תָּמָר palm-tree, ib. ) 2. cluster of henna-flowers, הַכֹּפֶר ׳ א (see כפר ), metaphor of the beloved one Song 1:14 . (compare Grünwald Israel. Letterbode, Amst., xi. 148 f. )

אֶשְׁכּוֺל (אֶשְׁכֹּל Song 7:8) noun masculineNum 13:23 cluster (Ethiopic , Arabic , Aramaic אִיתְכְּלָא; etymology dubious; Thes MV below √ שׁכל, but no suitable meaning proven; Sta§ 258; 300 derives from √ אשׁך with afformative ל) — ׳א absolute Num 13:24 +; construct vNum 13:23 +; plural אַשְׁכֹּלוֺת Song 7:8 construct אַשְׁכְּלֹת Deut 32:32, אֶשְׁכְּלוֺת Song 7:9 suffix אַשְׁכְּלֹתֶיהָ Gen 40:10 —

1. cluster of grapes, עֲנָבִים ׳א Num 13:23 compare vNum 13:24 see also Gen 40:10 הִבְשִׁילוּ עֲנָבִים ׳א its clusters ripened grapes; hence figurative of deeds of enemies of Israel, clusters of gall have they Deut 32:32 (|| עִנְבֵי רוֺשׁ); figurative of Israel Isa 65:8 ׳יִמָּצֵא הַתִּירוֺשׁ בְּא; Mic 7:1 אֵין אֶשְׁכּוֺל לֶאֱכוֺל figurative of desolation of Israel under Yahweh's judgment; Song 7:9 in simile שָׁדַיִךְ כְּאֶשְׁכְּלוֺת הַגֶּפֶן compare v.Song 7:8 (where Thes MV think of clusters of dates, see תָּמָר palm-tree, ib.)
2. cluster of henna-flowers, הַכֹּפֶר ׳א (see כפר), metaphor of the beloved one Song 1:14. (compare GrünwaldIsrael. Letterbode, Amst., xi. 148 f.)
